"""Gate 21 diagnostic (not a product test): gemv_nf4_rows vs per-row gemv_nf4 vs an fp64 reference on gfx1151 for the
forced "bytes" kernel, flat (non-nested) quant, 4096 x 14336, the case tests/test_nf4_triton_gemv.py fails at bsz 6.
Prints DIAG_NF4 JSON and fails on purpose."""

import json

import pytest
import torch

if not torch.cuda.is_available():
    pytest.skip("needs a GPU", allow_module_level = True)
F = pytest.importorskip("bitsandbytes.functional")

from unsloth.kernels import nf4_gemv
from unsloth.kernels.nf4_gemv import gemv_nf4, gemv_nf4_rows


def _args(q, s):
    return (q, s.absmax, None, None, None, s.code, s.blocksize, None, s.shape, s.dtype)


def test_nf4_rows_diag(monkeypatch):
    rep = {}
    for force in ("bytes", None):
        monkeypatch.setattr(nf4_gemv, "_FORCE_KERNEL", force)
        for shape in ((4096, 14336), (1024, 4096)):
            g = torch.Generator(device = "cuda").manual_seed(0)
            W = torch.randn(*shape, dtype = torch.bfloat16, device = "cuda", generator = g)
            q, s = F.quantize_4bit(W, quant_type = "nf4", compress_statistics = False)
            a = _args(q, s)
            dense = F.dequantize_4bit(q, s).double()
            for bsz in (2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10):
                for seed in (0, 1):
                    gx = torch.Generator(device = "cuda").manual_seed(100 + seed)
                    X = torch.randn(bsz, 1, shape[1], dtype = torch.bfloat16, device = "cuda", generator = gx)
                    wide = torch.zeros(bsz, 1, shape[0] + 64, dtype = torch.bfloat16, device = "cuda")
                    gemv_nf4_rows(X, *a[:-1], wide[:, :, : shape[0]])
                    rows = wide[:, 0, : shape[0]].float()
                    ones = torch.stack([gemv_nf4(X[i : i + 1].contiguous(), *a)[0].reshape(-1) for i in range(bsz)]).float()
                    ref = (X.double().view(bsz, -1) @ dense.t())
                    d = (rows - ones).abs()
                    per_row = []
                    for i in range(bsz):
                        tol = 2 * torch.finfo(torch.bfloat16).eps * ones[i].abs().max()
                        per_row.append([round(float(d[i].max()), 4), round(float((d[i] > 0).float().mean()), 4), bool(d[i].max() <= tol and (d[i] > 0).float().mean() < 0.01)])
                    rep[f"{force}-{shape[0]}x{shape[1]}-b{bsz}-s{seed}"] = {
                        "rows_vs_fp64": float(((rows.double() - ref).abs().max() / ref.abs().max())),
                        "ones_vs_fp64": float(((ones.double() - ref).abs().max() / ref.abs().max())),
                        "per_row": per_row, "tail_zero": not wide[:, :, shape[0]:].any().item()}
    bad = {k: v for k, v in rep.items() if not all(r[2] for r in v["per_row"])}
    print("DIAG_NF4 " + json.dumps(rep))
    pytest.fail("diagnostic only: failing cells " + json.dumps(bad)[:1400])
